items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: One tmp-dir-built scenario crosses U1 tag, U3 review record (trivial/small/medium), U4 cascade (small), U5 surface (medium), U6 requirement gates; each gate asserted with its own diagnostic and every other gate asserted green. U7 was cut from the campaign and is not covered.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Test-only; fixtures raise on git failure (check=True); no production code touched.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No shell, git through argument arrays in tmp_path repos; no secrets; no network.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Baseline passes at 3 complexities; each case breaks one claim and fails if a second gate is red (masking) or the owning gate accepts; converse all-broken case; F11 entry-point wiring case. Mutations confirmed red during development (U3 medium needed a real review row).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: 20 cases in ~25 s; each builds a small real git repo.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: test file 211 lines, helper 58 lines, both under 300; iterate_checks.py untouched; helper has no test_* function.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The scenario IS the round-trip probe: records written in production shapes (review record via lib.review_record, evidence via evidence_drop.stage_reports, F5c entry) are read back by the real verifiers.
